subject: gk
question: Which of the following statements is INCORRECT about redworms ?

options.text: A redworm can eat food equal to its own weight, in a day.
Redworms need dry surroundings for their survival.
They have a structure called ‘gizzard’, which helps them in grinding their food.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Redworms need dry surroundings for their survival**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Redworms do not have teeth. They have a structure called ‘gizzard’, which helps them in grinding their food. 
 
• A redworm can eat food equal to its own weight, in a day.
 
• Redworms do not survive in very hot or very cold surroundings. They also need moisture around them.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• Red worms are more commonly known as **red wigglers**.
 
• These are the earthworms employed in** vermicomposting**.
 
• **Eisenia fetida **is the scientific name for Redworms.
 
• The species is** hermaphroditic** (can produce gametes related to both males and females).
 
• The **Cerebral Ganglion** helps them sense moisture, Heat, Light, and Vibrations.
 
• These creatures have** 5 hearts **that regulate the flow of nutrients and oxygen.
 
• Their **Pharynx sucks** in the food that travels down to the oesophagus, crop.
 
• And then to **gizzard** where even the hard soil particles are crushed.
 
• Thereafter** intestines** digest the food. Nutrients are absorbed and waste is excreted.
 
• Their** excreta** is used as fertilizer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vermicomposting **is a process in which earthworms are used to convert** organic** materials into humus-like material known as **vermicompost**.
